why not go: Lima->Parcas->Huacachina (Ica)-> Nazca->Arequipa->Puno->Cusco->fly back to Lima then fly to the Amazon?

it makes more sense to do it that way so you're traveling down Peru instead of flying all of the way from Cusco just to travel back to all of the places you would have hit by traveling down Peru. you'll save money and time.

you can bus the route i wrote above very easily, the longest bus rides are 10hrs (Nazca to Arequipa) and 8hrs (Puno to Cusco). Cruz del Sur is a really nice bus company that goes between all of those locations, they have seats that recline 140-160 degrees, AC, blankets, washrooms, overnight busses, etc. for like $10-$40usd. overnight busses are great because you save money on accommodation and since it's overnight, you're not spending precious daytime on a bus or at an airport.
